name: @pipeworx/mcp-stat-lv

tools.name: subjects
tools.description: Navigate the subject tree. Root (empty path) lists database folders (e.g. OSP_PUB); drill into sub-paths — entries with type "l" are folders, type "t" are tables.

path.description: Sub-path under the API base (default empty = root, lists databases like OSP_PUB).

tools.name: table_meta
tools.description: Table definition (dimensions, valid values). Use the bare table path with no ".px" suffix.

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: Pull data from a table. body is a PxWeb query object. Use the bare table path with no ".px" suffix.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-stat-lv forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the stat-lv pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
